parsed.root_cause: An unauthorized personal Wi-Fi router is operating on the exact same channel (Channel 6) with a much stronger signal strength (-45dBm vs -68dBm) near the west side of the office, causing severe co-channel interference and performance degradation for clients connected to Corporate-AP1.
parsed.evidence: Site survey scan shows 'MyHomeWifi' broadcasting on Channel 6 with an RSSI of -45dBm, directly overlapping with Corporate-AP1 on Channel 6 which has an RSSI of -68dBm.
parsed.next_command: show wireless client summary (or examine AP radio settings to check channel utilization and noise floor)
fix_steps: Locate and physically remove or shut down the unauthorized personal Wi-Fi router ('MyHomeWifi').
Reconfigure Corporate-AP1 and Corporate-AP2 to use non-overlapping channels (1, 6, 11) with proper channel planning.
Verify west side employees regain stable connection speeds and proper signal quality.
